categories.label: Billing & Payments
categories.description: Questions and problems about invoices, charges and payments.

categories.label: Invoice Questions
categories.description: Customer wants an invoice, bill line items or billing cycle explained, or requests a copy of a bill.

categories.label: Billing Disputes
categories.description: Customer believes a charge on the bill is wrong, unexpected or duplicated and wants it corrected or refunded.

categories.label: Payment Issues
categories.description: Problems paying a bill: failed or declined payments, payment methods, direct debit and payment arrangements.

categories.label: Network & Connectivity
categories.description: Problems with mobile network service quality and availability.

categories.label: Mobile Data
categories.description: Mobile internet performance: data is slow, unstable or not working, or the data connection cannot be established. Not about how much data was used or billed.

categories.label: Voice Connectivity
categories.description: Problems making or receiving calls, dropped calls and poor call quality.

categories.label: Network Coverage
categories.description: No signal, coverage gaps and network outages in an area.

categories.label: Account & SIM
categories.description: Managing the customer account, SIM cards and access credentials.

categories.label: SIM Management
categories.description: Activating, replacing, swapping or blocking SIM and eSIM cards.

categories.label: Account Access
categories.description: Logging in to the online account or app, passwords, locked accounts and verification codes.

categories.label: Customer Details
categories.description: Updating personal details such as address, name, email or contact preferences.

categories.label: Products & Services
categories.description: Tariffs, bundles, top-ups, contracts and number portability.

categories.label: Tariff Management
categories.description: Changing, comparing or understanding the customer's base tariff or price plan, including upgrading or downgrading to a plan with more or less data.

categories.label: Data & Service Bundles
categories.description: Buying, activating or removing add-on bundles, data packs and service options, and questions about remaining data allowance or how data usage is counted.

categories.label: Prepaid Top-ups
categories.description: Topping up prepaid credit, missing or failed top-ups and prepaid balance questions.

categories.label: Contract & Subscription Management
categories.description: Contract terms, renewals, cancellations and recurring subscriptions.

categories.label: Number Portability
categories.description: Porting a phone number to or from another operator.
